title: Worst Car Warranties! (And Best)
summary: A service advisor says aftermarket car warranty companies vary hugely in claim approval and are driven by heavy marketing and high commissions.

assertions.quote: there's probably less than a 50% rate of approval when they are calling to get repairs approved

verdicts.note: Consistent with many consumer and BBB complaints about denial rates at specific companies, though no independent industry-wide audit confirms exact figures.

assertions.quote: one of the biggest marketing campaigns I've seen in a long while is from one of the lowest rated warranty companies out there

verdicts.note: This is a correlation drawn from one shop's anecdotal experience, not an independently verified industry pattern.
CarShield spent heavily on celebrity-endorsed advertising (Ice-T, Chris Berman) while its plans turned out to carry myriad exclusions and many denied claims.

assertions.quote: they find some sneaky way to get out of it
they actually make the dealerships make more money off of the item that they add on at the end of the sale
